title: Concrete grade for beams and slab not stated
detail: General notes give M25 for the staircase and "refer chart" for columns, but no grade for beams and slabs. M25 is assumed; it sets the cement content and the development length.
ask: Confirm concrete grade for second floor beams and slab.

title: Clear cover and lap / anchorage length not stated for beams and slabs
detail: Note 10 gives cover for columns, walls and footings only. 25 mm cover and Ld = 50d are assumed. IS 456 gives about 53d for Fe550 in M25.
ask: Confirm clear cover (beams / slabs) and lap or development length.

title: B5 size: 9″ × 24″ on the layout, 9″ × 18″ in the schedule
detail: The shuttering layout labels B5 as 9″ × 24″; the beam schedule details it as 9″ × 18″. 18″ is used, which affects concrete and stirrup length.
ask: Which depth is correct for B5?

title: Beam numbers B42, B46, B51 and B89 do not appear
detail: These numbers are missing from the layout and both schedules. Treated as numbering gaps, not missing beams. The site notebook does list B42, B46, B51 and B89, so check which beams the QS means.
ask: Confirm B42, B46, B51, B89 are unused numbers.

title: Schedule sheet 2 repeats the B68–B73 row from sheet 1
detail: The same row of elevations appears on both schedule sheets. Counted once.
ask: Confirm the repeated row is a duplicate and not a second set of beams.

title: One slab panel marked 6″ thick on the bottom slab layout
detail: General note says "slab thickness 5″ THK UNO"; one panel is marked 6″ on MC-SD-06-04. The slab is taken as 5″ throughout.
ask: Which panel is 6″, and over what area?
